lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in approximately five discernible horizontal rows extending posteriorly from the gill region. The spots in the medial rows exhibit the highest pixel intensity and most regular circular morphology.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes, most prominent in the anterior-superior section of the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single, prominent longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs is visible on the first dorsal fin silhouette, primarily clustered along the anterior base and leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (family Echeneidae) attached to the ventral surface of the shark, visible as an elongated dark silhouette with a distinct caudal profile.
